generation: Deterministic metre-based terrain, closed chipped/layered cliff, plinth, opaque folded grass and shrub leaves, buried rock clusters. Seed 41723. Photographic Seaside Rock (Dimitrios Savva, 2m) and Aerial Grass Rock (Rob Tuytel, 15m), Poly Haven CC0. Coast-arc/height UV, macro/strata colour, damp lower wall, shore rock blend. Analytic linear RGBE sky shares the sunlight direction with the rendered sky and scoped outdoor sun; 128-face HDR prefilter and one cached 1024 local shadow. No AI-generated assets or photographic scenery walls. Ground PBR uses translation-only hex blending, identical geometry weights for albedo/normal/ARM; no tangent rotation. Coast columns share shading normals across patch boundaries, with hard vertical ledges. World-anchored near-dense/far-coarse ocean, three analytic displacement waves, filtered crossing ripple normals, linear Fresnel sky reflection and rough GGX sunlight from the same sky parameters, exterior-only marine haze. A generated 256x256 RGBA8 signed-distance/seabed field intersects the closed rock wall at mean sea level and controls water colour and animated broken foam. No additional image download or ocean reflection/refraction target.
supersedes: Forest Slope panorama and bark no longer ship or load in the current scene; historical originals and provenance remain in the repository and frozen eight-room-v1 baseline.
limitations: Ocean sky reflection excludes local house/cliff reflections. Mean-sea-level shoreline and sloping seabed approximation do not track individual wave crests; no fluid physics. Grass/low shrubs remain static simplified geometry. Indoor HDR, existing room lights, mirrors and interactions are retained. Final multi-platform acceptance remains stage D.
